part.text:
Fixed. The header filename (and filesize) are now wrapped to the terminal width in `src/printer.rs`:

- Added `get_header_component_indent_length`, `print_header_component_with_indent`, and `print_header_multiline_component` helpers (src/printer.rs:290-329) that hard-wrap header content at `term_width - indent` and print continuation lines with the proper grid/panel indent.
- `print_header` now routes the filename (kind + title + mode) and filesize through the multiline wrapper instead of a plain `writeln!`.

Verification: `cargo test` passes fully with default features (including `header_narrow_terminal` and `header_very_narrow_terminal`), and with `--no-default-features --features minimal-application` only two pre-existing, unrelated failures remain (`cache_build`, `diagnostic_sanity_check` — they fail on the unmodified baseline too).
